title: Minimum Operations to Make All Array Elements Equal
summary: Given an array of positive integers and a set of queries, for each query, determine the minimum operations needed to make all array elements equal to the query value.
statement: Given an array of positive integers and a set of queries, for each query, determine the minimum operations needed to make all array elements equal to the query value. Operations include incrementing or decrementing any element by one, and the array returns to its original state after each query.
constraints: For each query, independently make every number equal to that query using unit increments or decrements.
The array resets before the next query.
Return the minimum operation count for every query in order.
reference_solution:
def operations_to_match_queries(nums,queries):
    import bisect
    ordered=sorted(nums);prefix=[0]
    for value in ordered:prefix.append(prefix[-1]+value)
    answer=[]
    for query in queries:
        index=bisect.bisect_left(ordered,query)
        left=query*index-prefix[index]
        right=prefix[-1]-prefix[index]-query*(len(ordered)-index)
        answer.append(left+right)
    return answer

def operations_to_match_queries(nums,queries):
    import bisect
    ordered=sorted(nums);prefix=[0]
    for value in ordered:prefix.append(prefix[-1]+value)
    answer=[]
    for query in queries:
        index=bisect.bisect_left(ordered,query)
        left=query*index-prefix[index]
        right=prefix[-1]-prefix[index]-query*(len(ordered)-index)
        answer.append(abs(left-right))
    return answer
hints: Sort nums once and build prefix sums.
Binary-search the first value not smaller than each query.
Use the prefix sum to compute the cost of raising the left side and lowering the right side.
Adding those independent costs gives the minimum for one query in logarithmic time after sorting.
